exposure: Trial of labor after a previous cesarean section (TOLAC)
cohort: 830 women with singleton pregnancy and a previous cesarean section (CS) who presented with PROM and underwent TOLAC
finding: Induction of labor following PROM in women with a previous CS is associated with a high successful vaginal delivery rate but significantly increased risk for uterine rupture and operative and maternal complications compared to spontaneous initiation of labor.
mod_finding: The rate of successful TOLAC was similar between the induction of labor group and the conservative treatment and spontaneous labor group (75.7 vs. 81.6%, respectively, p = .22).
